title: fix: C_SeedRandom and C_GenerateRandom return wrong CKR codes
description:
pkcs11test ReadOnlySessionTest.SeedRandom, SeedRandomBadArguments, GenerateRandom confirm:
- C_SeedRandom with a valid session returns wrong code (expected CKR_RANDOM_NO_RNG=0x121 if seeding not supported)
- C_SeedRandom with pSeed=NULL should return CKR_ARGUMENTS_BAD but does not
- C_SeedRandom with invalid session handle should return CKR_SESSION_HANDLE_INVALID but does not
- C_GenerateRandom returns wrong code

PKCS#11 2.40 §11.15: C_SeedRandom returns CKR_RANDOM_SEED_NOT_SUPPORTED if seeding is not supported, or CKR_RANDOM_NO_RNG if no RNG. C_GenerateRandom must validate session handle and NULL pointer.

Fix: Audit C_SeedRandom and C_GenerateRandom for: (1) session handle validation, (2) NULL pointer checks with CKR_ARGUMENTS_BAD, (3) correct error codes for unsupported seeding.
